title: Chapter 72 The Palace Of The Human Emperor And The Xuanyuan Sword
content:
Chapter 72 The Palace Of The Human Emperor And The Xuanyuan Sword

First of all, it was the material. The last time he built the deserted city when he was in the Destiny Realm.

At that time, the highest level of material he could use was the ancient divine gold.

Now that he has reached the True Self Realm, the level of material he can use is naturally higher.

Soon, Lu Daosheng set his sights on a material called Divine Source Gold.

"It's you!"

Then, countless Divine Source Golds continued to appear in Lu Daosheng's palm.

At the same time, Lu Daosheng used his magical powers to start refining.

It must be said that this Divine Source Gold is indeed good. Even if Lu Daosheng is now refining it with the strength of the True Self Realm, it will take a long time.

In this space, Lu Daosheng refined it for 7749 days before he refined the prototype of the new deserted city.

Looking at the new deserted city in his hand, Lu Daosheng smiled with satisfaction.

Then, Lu Daosheng waved his hand again, and suddenly, countless rule powers belonging to him were injected into the city.

In an instant, the deserted city seemed to come alive, and the restrictions inside it exuded a terrifying aura.

The next moment, Lu Daosheng appeared in the void outside the Wanling Realm.

I saw a colorful sky thunder coming straight down from the void and directly struck the new deserted city in Lu Daosheng's hand.

Suddenly, the whole deserted city began to continuously exude a strong aura.

And this deserted city was officially formed.

Finally, Lu Daosheng injected the world law into the deserted city again. This time, this new deserted city was countless times larger than the deserted city in the Wanling Realm.

Under Lu Daosheng's operation, this deserted city began to improve continuously.

Several dojos rose from the deserted city, and the deserted city lord's mansion in the center was directly suspended in the sky. Countless innate spiritual liquids flowed down from the city lord's mansion like a waterfall, which was spectacular.

The style was directly pulled to the maximum.

"Well, that's it."

Looking at the New Wasteland City in his hand, Lu Daosheng nodded with satisfaction.

Now, the city is there, but people are missing.

Thinking of this, Lu Daosheng sighed.

Lu Daosheng really hasn't thought of the candidates for the New Wasteland City.

Gu Chen and his people are not strong enough now, and even if they enter the New Wasteland City, they can't play any role.

It seems that we have to go back to our old business and pick up people everywhere.

But let's put this matter aside for now, because Lu Xue and the others haven't come out of the ruins yet.

I don't know what's going on now.

Then Lu Daosheng returned to the wasteland city.

At the same time, in the ruins of the Human Emperor Palace.

After many difficulties, Lu Xue and others finally reached the deepest part of the Human Emperor Palace.

This journey is really full of dangers. If you are not careful, even Ouyang Yanqing, who is in the realm of the Heavenly King, is in danger of his life.

Fortunately, Lu Xue has many treasures, so the few people are safe.

At this time, the restrictions outside the Human Emperor Palace had also dissipated, and countless creatures had entered the ruins.

However, because Lu Xue and the others were in the deepest part, they could not meet other creatures.

"Xiaoxue, wait a minute."

At this moment, Ouyang Yanqing suddenly spoke.

Suddenly, several people stopped.

"Sister Ouyang, what's wrong?"

Lu Xue asked in confusion.

It looked quite quiet around here.

However, Ouyang Yanqing looked a little solemn, "I feel a strange breath."

Hearing this, An Xing also frowned.

The next moment, An Xing directly exerted a black aura.

Domain.

Suddenly, An Xing's expression changed drastically, and he quickly turned his head to look forward.

"Miss, be careful!"

As if sensing something, An Xing quickly stood in front of Lu Xue and stared at the front cautiously.

Seeing this, Ouyang Yanqing also quickly entered a state of preparation.

At the original place, Lu Xue was also somewhat inexplicably nervous by the two people, and then quickly patted her arm.

"Stupid dragon! Don't sleep!!"

Hearing this, Ao Qing suddenly woke up and poked his head out.

"Hey, young master, don't worry, I'm watching. With me here, nothing will happen."

Hearing Ao Qing's words, Lu Xue rolled her eyes directly.

If I depended on you for protection, I would have died hundreds of times.

At this moment, a deep voice sounded from the scene.

"The Realm of Nothingness, hehe, it's quite interesting."

Hearing this, Lu Xue trembled all over, and the next moment, an illusory figure suddenly appeared in front of him.

It was a middle-aged man with long hair shawl.

His clothes were covered with strange patterns, and his eyes were like stars.

Seeing this middle-aged man, a strong sense of crisis emerged in the hearts of Lu Xue and others.

So strong.

"Who are you?"

Looking at the middle-aged man, Ouyang Yanqing said in a deep voice.

Hearing this, the middle-aged man smiled.

"You entered my Human Emperor Palace, but you still ask who I am?"

Hearing this, Ouyang Yanqing reacted immediately, and then said in shock: "You, you are the Lord of the Human Emperor Palace?!"

Aside, An Xing and Lu Xue were also shocked.

The Lord of the Human Emperor Palace is still alive?

Why?

All of a sudden, countless questions filled the minds of several people.

As if he saw what Lu Xue and the others were thinking, the middle-aged man shook his head and said: "Don't think about it, I died a long time ago, this is just a part of the power I left behind."

Part of the power? !

Part of the power is already so strong, then how strong must the Lord of the Human Emperor Palace be in its heyday.

At this time, An Xing said: "Senior, you left some power behind, and now the Human Emperor Palace has been born again. I think this is not a coincidence."

Hearing this, the middle-aged man smiled and said: "You are very smart."

"Yes, I do have a purpose."

"I didn't expect that after so many years, my human race still has strong people like you in the Wanling Realm. It seems that I was too worried back then."

He thought that the three major forces of the human race would be destroyed and the human race would usher in the darkest period.

But I didn't expect that there are still strong people in the Tianjun realm in the Wanling Realm now, and they are not ordinary Tianjun realm strong people.

In this way, it seems that the human race will not live too badly.

Hearing this, Lu Xue and others were silent.

Before they came to the Wanling Realm from the Wasteland City, the human race did not live very well in the Wanling Realm.

"Senior, what is your purpose?"

At this time, Lu Xue asked.

Looking at Lu Xue, the middle-aged man's face suddenly brightened.

What a strong luck.

This was the first time he had seen such a strong luck on a living being. It was simply, even stronger than the luck of the entire world of all spirits.

Then the middle-aged man said: "The inheritance of my Human Emperor Palace cannot be broken."

At this time, the middle-aged man looked straight at Lu Xue, and the meaning was self-evident.

Seeing this, Ouyang Yanqing and An Xing were overjoyed.

The Human Emperor Palace was so powerful in the past, how precious the inheritance of the Human Emperor Palace must be.

Moreover, such a strong man should not be willing to deceive.

Then the two hurriedly said: "Xiaoxue (Miss), please agree!"

Hearing this, Lu Xue was silent.

Why did she feel that she was forced to do anything.

At this time, the Xuanyuan Sword in her hand suddenly began to tremble.

Seeing the Xuanyuan Sword, the middle-aged man smiled and said: "Oh? Your sword is not bad, huh? Wait!!"

Suddenly, the middle-aged man suddenly came in front of Lu Xue, staring at the Xuanyuan Sword in Lu Xue's hand.

Bloodshot eyes.

"Xuan, Xuanyuan Sword!!"

"Hey, where did you come from?"

At this time, the middle-aged man's eyes were full of disbelief, as if he had seen a ghost.

People only know about the Human Emperor Palace, but they don't know how it was founded.

In ancient times, the human race was in a weak position, and the other races were extremely strong. The human race had to survive in the cracks, and was forced to become slaves by countless races.

Until later, a great existence appeared among the human race.

He created a practice method suitable for the human race, and led the human race to compete with all races.

In the end, the human race won.

Since then, the human race has also begun its road to prosperity.

And that great existence was revered as the Human Emperor by later generations.

He was also the first generation of the Human Emperor.

And the Xuanyuan Sword was the weapon held by the Human Emperor back then.

Although all this is just a legend and cannot be verified, the Xuanyuan Sword is real.

Because the historical records in the Palace of the Emperor of Humanity show that when the Palace of the Emperor of Humanity was founded, the Xuanyuan Sword was the treasure of the Palace of the Emperor of Humanity.

However, an incident occurred later, which led to a significant reduction in the strength of the Palace of the Emperor of Humanity.

And the Xuanyuan Sword disappeared from the Palace of the Emperor of Humanity since then.
